test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the compound interest on Rs. 10000 in 1 year 6 month at 10% per annum, the interest being compounded half yearly?
solution:
Given:

Principal (P) = Rs. 10000

Time (t) = 1 year 6 months = 1.5 years

Rate of interest (r) = 10% per annum, compounded half yearly

Find compound interest (CI)

**Concept: **

Compound Interest = P(1 + r/n)(nt)<
